title: OCI repository settings
description: The oci member of a repository document (R-REPO-004, R-OCI-026). A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable. Local and virtual repositories have no settings of the format.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: What a mirror of a registry keeps (R-OCI-026, Q-OCI-16): the tags, the tags never kept and the platforms of the indexes. Present in both modes of a remote repository and effective in mode mirror.

tags.title: Tags to mirror
tags.description: Tag patterns ('*' and '?') a tag must match to be mirrored; a pattern without a wildcard names a tag that is always kept.

excludeTags.title: Tags never mirrored
excludeTags.description: Tag patterns that are never mirrored.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Platforms ('os/arch' or 'os/arch/variant') of an index whose manifests are mirrored; empty is every platform.
